text:
acme-dev: Hey team — after the v2.3.1 rollout this morning our CI started failing. The generated TypeScript from the codegen endpoint suddenly has missing imports and a runtime stub omitted. Minimal repro attached.

acme-dev: Prompt we used: `/* generate client for Acme Payments */` + example usage. Model: redwood-codegen-v2.3.1 (default). Response trimmed:
```ts
export function chargeUser(userId: string, amount: number) {
  const resp = http.post(`/charge`, { userId, amount });
  return resp.data;
}
```

acme-dev: CI error: `TS2304: Cannot find name 'http'. Did you mean 'HttpClient'?` Also our linter flags missing export types, and a helper `formatCurrency` that used to be included is absent. Worked before this morning.

maya: Ack — sorry about the break. Can you paste the raw response (full message) or a link to the request id?

acme-dev: full response (truncated safe bits):
```json
{
  "file": "client.ts",
  "content": "export function chargeUser(userId: string, amount: number) {\n  const resp = http.post(`/charge`, { userId, amount });\n  return resp.data;\n}\n\nexport function refund(id: string) {\n  // NOTE: missing helper generateHeaders()\n  return api.post(`/refund/${id}`);\n}\n"\n}
```

samir: Thanks — this screams like a prompt-to-template mapping regression. v2.3.1 changed how imports are selected for TS templates (we landed a small optimization to remove unused helpers). If the model now omits small helper functions because of token budget changes that could produce missing defs.

eli: @samir adding: we also changed default code style from "module" to "esnext" in the codegen templates last rollout. That can change generated import shapes. Could be an interaction where helper functions were inlined previously but now expected to be imported.

maya: Jordan, can you pull the request logs for the rollout? Need the exact kernel/compile flag change and the template version.

jordan: grabbing logs. Support-bot: created incident INC-2024-089 for customer report.

jordan: Found relevant change: template-ts v4.9 rolled at 08:02 UTC, along with memory/kv-cache tweak. Also model variant alias changed mapping from `redwood-codegen-v2` -> `redwood-codegen-v2.3.1`.

samir: Repro plan: 1) run codegen with same prompt and `model=redwood-codegen-v2` (pre-rollout) 2) run with `redwood-codegen-v2.3.1` 3) diff generated files for missing helper functions/imports and any style flags.

acme-dev: We can run that, but CI needs a hotfix. Any quick mitigation?

eli: Short-term: pin model to `redwood-codegen-v2` or set template override to `template-ts:v4.8` (pre-rollout). I'll create a rollout rollback PR if diffs show regression.

maya: Also gathering a small set of failing snippets from a few other customers — seems limited to client generation flows that rely on inline helper consolidation. Could be regression in helper extraction logic.

samir: If anyone can share 1) request id(s) and 2) the prompt + generation parameters (temperature, max_tokens, stop) we can reproduce exactly.

acme-dev: Request id: rwd-req-2024-0829-9911. Params: temperature=0.0, max_tokens=512, template=template-ts (default). We'll try pin and report back.

support-bot: @oncall-notify deployed.

maya: Good repro. @eng-ml / @eng-runtime can you prioritize a diff and assessment? If confirmed, we will rollback template-ts or patch helper extraction. I'll update INC-2024-089 and notify customer. :thumbsup:

acme-dev: Thanks. Pinning model fixed our CI temporarily. Please keep us updated, this blocks our staging deploys.

samir: Noted. Will post findings in thread and link to PR/rollback timeline.
